literal_meaning: অবিরাম টপটপ করে প্রবাহিত হওয়া (continuous dripping or flowing sound)
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভাপসা গরমে পরিশ্রম করে সে দরদর করে ঘামছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He was sweating profusely from hard work in the humid heat.
The rain is pouring down continuously.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali to mimic the sound of continuous dripping, often for sweat or rain.
